# QuickOps 快维

> Open-source Agno-powered AI operations assistant for single-node and intranet environments, with a persistent Shell per conversation, real host telemetry, four AI permission levels, HITL approvals, command auditing, and an offline Linux installer.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/bobo-study/QuickOps

Chinese is the primary project language; English documentation is included. The assistant is named 小维 (Xiaowei). Current version v0.0.1 is an early preview maintained by 动感光波 (@bobo-study) under Apache-2.0.

## Essential

- [Project facts](https://bobo-study.github.io/QuickOps/ai-discovery.md): Citation-ready identity, scope, capabilities, limitations, and FAQ in Chinese and English.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bobo-study/QuickOps/main/README.md): Bilingual overview and installation.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bobo-study/QuickOps/main/docs/architecture.md): Agno runtime, security policy, terminal model, and persistence.
- [Release](https://github.com/bobo-study/QuickOps/releases/latest): Latest installer and release notes.
- [CodeMeta](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bobo-study/QuickOps/main/codemeta.json): Structured software metadata.
